title: Verify Zedu marketing emails render and work before a campaign is sent
description: Quality-check approved marketing-email templates independently of copywriting and SPF/DKIM/DMARC work. Deliver a representative client/device matrix, plain-text versions, link/UTM checks, image-blocked and narrow-screen checks, accessible reading order and a reproducible defect/retest log. Use offline previews or an explicitly approved test-mail setup; mark unavailable Gmail/Outlook/mobile coverage as untested. Done when blocking issues in the selected approved templates are resolved or explicitly accepted, and every tested result has dated evidence. Never call a preview an inbox test. No customer email, paid testing service or live automation changes without approval.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Render each approved template offline with a scripted matrix, then confirm in approved seed inboxes
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Most of the matrix can be done reproducibly without any paid service or live send. Plan: 1) render each approved HTML template in headless Chrome at 320, 480 and 600 px wide, with images on and images blocked, and save dated screenshots; generate and check the plain-text version; 2) run a script that lists every link with its final URL after redirects, its HTTP status and whether the UTM tags are present and consistent, and checks the basics of accessible markup (lang attribute, alt text, reading order, colour contrast of text against background); 3) only with an approved test-mail setup, send to seed Gmail, Outlook and mobile inboxes and record what renders; anything not tested is marked untested, and previews are never called inbox tests. Deliver the matrix, the defect and retest log, and the scripts. Tasks: offline render and link check (other), seed-inbox check and retest log (other).

pendingIdeas.title: Add the two checks most matrices miss: dark-mode rendering and Gmail's 102 KB clipping limit
pendingIdeas.description: The accepted workstreams build the client/device matrix and render tests. Two common failures sit outside a normal matrix. Dark mode in Gmail, Apple Mail and Outlook can invert colours, so logos vanish and text becomes unreadable. Gmail also clips any message over about 102 KB of HTML, hiding the footer and the unsubscribe link. Approach: render each approved template in dark mode on the clients the matrix covers, record the issues with screenshots, measure each template's HTML size, and give the fix (transparent logo variants, colour-scheme meta, trimmed markup). Done: the dark-mode and size results per template, and the fixes added to the retest log.
